title: read_chunk request
description: The params object of the `read_chunk` tool. The authoritative content of one chunk returned by a search. Principal labels are never a caller field: the host supplies the scope (docs/tool-schemas.md).

chunk_id.description: A chunk_id from a previous result.

path_prefix.description: Scope check; a chunk outside it reads as unknown.

roots.description: Root ids to search. Narrows the server's roots, never widens them; absent or null means every root the server allows.
